# NADAC Lookup

> Free NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost) price lookup for U.S. pharmacies. Search by drug name or NDC, compare costs, and track weekly CMS updates.

NADAC Lookup helps independent pharmacy owners and pharmacists access the latest CMS NADAC drug acquisition costs, updated every Wednesday. Pro plans add unlimited saves, full price history, and price-change alerts for $29/mo.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search NADAC drug prices by name or NDC.
- [Weekly Movers](/movers): Top 5 NADAC price increases and decreases each week.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free vs Pro ($29/mo) plans.
- [Features](/features): Watchlists, alerts, comparisons, and price history.
- [About](/about): Mission and data sources.
- [What Is NADAC](/what-is-nadac): Explainer on the NADAC pricing benchmark.
- [How Often NADAC Updates](/how-often-does-nadac-update): Weekly Wednesday update schedule.
- [Blog](/blog): Pharmacy pricing guides and PBM strategy.
